fichas.title: Subsidiary and storage areas for experimental theatres
fichas.summary: Open-stage theatres need subsidiary areas for scenery, platforms, and stands, together with storage space. The subsidiary areas should match the stage in size; the text states that subsidiary areas plus storage amount to about 30% of the total area. Open stages use less scenery because they are viewed from many sides and safety regulations restrict scenery.

fichas.title: Storage for large stages
fichas.summary: Large-stage storage accommodates scenery, backdrops, furniture, props, costumes, and related items. Scenery stores should be at stage level and immediately adjacent to the stage, with access routes and openings planned for scenery height and fire protection. Storage needs depend on repertoire and production frequency; the text describes traditional backdrop storage and container-based, computer-controlled storage systems.

Scenery store:
Specially for heavy items. Location: at stage level and immediately
next to the stage. At access points and on traffic routes (particularly
at fire exits and lifts), the height of the scenery, normally proscenium
height+ 2 m, must be taken into account.

A rough estimate for the size of the scenery and costume store
can be made from the number of productions in the repertoire and
the frequency with which they are played. For theatres the number
of productions might be 15-20 and for multi-purpose theatres and
opera up to 50 per season. About 20-25% of the stage area is
required for storage per production, i.e. for theatres about 3 times
the stage area, for the opera at least 10 times. Practice shows
that, as time passes, the store always turns out to be too small,
and theatres, and particularly operas, have to make arrangements
outside the building.
The high cost of transport has forced the introduction of the
most modern transportation and storage technology: container
systems with computer-controlled warehouse technology (per
performance about 2-4 containers - in special cases for operas
about 12 containers).
